parts.name: ABS (Anti-lock Braking System)
parts.description: Two-channel ABS acting on the front and rear brakes. Honda: 'ABS is standard for 2026.'
parts.function: Watches wheel speed. If a wheel starts to lock under hard braking, the ABS modulator briefly releases and reapplies pressure many times a second, so the tire keeps grip and the rider keeps steering control.

facts.label: ABS
facts.value: Front and rear; standard on 2026 Rebel 500

parts.name: ABS Modulator
parts.description: A hydraulic control unit with valves, a pump and an electronic controller. Its location on the 2026 CMX500A is not yet verified, so no 3D geometry is drawn.
parts.function: Sits in the brake lines between the master cylinders and the calipers, and modulates brake pressure when a wheel is about to lock.
parts.verificationNote: An ABS modulator bracket is listed in the 2026 Rebel 500 catalog index. Location and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Wheel Speed Sensors
parts.description: Sensors at each wheel that read a toothed pulser ring.
parts.function: Report each wheel's speed to the ABS so it can detect impending lock-up.
